subject: Small Key
text: A chest through the small hole as Young Link contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Go up the stairs and through the small hole. Open the chest for a Small Key, then exit the temple and return as Adult Link.

subject: Recovery Heart
text: An invisible chest across from the east stairwell contains a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote: Hover across using the Hover Boots and find an invisible chest. Open it for a Recovery Heart.

subject: Small Key
text: An invisible chest near the second mirror contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Before heading back, see the bars near the second mirror? There's an invisible chest containing a Small Key there.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Tricking the Iron Knuckle into destroying the wall structures reveals two Gold Skulltulas.

evidence.quote: Inside is an Iron Knuckle. Now, before killing it, trick it into destroying the structures on the walls. This will reveal two Gold Skulltulas.

subject: Bombchus
text: A chest in the Spirit Trials of Ganon's Castle contains Bombchus.

evidence.quote: In this next room, kill the Green Bubble and open the chest for some Bombchus.

subject: Golden Gauntlets
text: Reflecting light onto the sun face just right of the barred-up door makes a chest containing the Golden Gauntlets appear.

evidence.quote: Reflect light at the sun face just right of the barred-up door and a chest will appear. Open it for the GOLDEN GAUNTLETS.

subject: Small Key
text: The sun face to the southwest when facing the door holds a chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote: the sun face to your southwest when facing the door holds a chest with a Small Key

subject: Great Fairy Fountain
text: Visiting the Great Fairy Fountain near Ganon's Castle doubles Link's defense.

evidence.quote: Now that you have the Golden Gauntlets, you can exit Ganon's Castle and visit the Great Fairy Fountain nearby to get your defense doubled.

subject: Small Key
text: A Small Key can be picked up above the door in the Forest Trials after Longshooting to the torch.

evidence.quote: Longshot to the torch above the door. Now, either wait for the fan to stop blowing, or put on your Iron Boots and walk over to pick up the Small Key.

subject: Arrows
text: Shooting the eye switch inside the fan on the right spawns a chest containing arrows.

evidence.quote: In this room, look into the fan on the right to spot an eye switch. Shoot it for a chest containing arrows.

subject: Bombs
text: Shooting a Fire Arrow at the frozen eye switch makes a chest containing Bombs appear.

evidence.quote: You will notice a frozen eye switch in one of the fans. Shoot a Fire Arrow at it to make a chest containing Bombs appear.

subject: Song of Time
text: Playing the Song of Time twice with Iron Boots on makes an Armos fall onto the blue switch below to open the door ahead.

evidence.quote: Put on the Iron Boots and play the Song of Time twice. This will make an Armos fall onto the blue switch below, opening the door ahead.

subject: Fire Trials
text: The Goron Tunic should be put on before entering the Fire Trials.

evidence.quote: Enter the Fire Trials, the door with the red medallion. Put on your Goron Tunic before entering.

subject: Red Rupee
text: Melting red ice in the Water Trials reveals a chest containing a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote: The main red ice to look for is the ones that are blocking the way forward, but another red ice has a chest containing a Red Rupee.

subject: Block Puzzle
text: To collect the Silver Rupees in the Water Trials, push the further block from the entrance into the rock and then into the hole, then push the other block south, east, and north.

evidence.quote: To do that, push the further block from the entrance door into the rock, then into the hole. Next, push the other block south, then east, then north.

subject: Arrows
text: Shooting the bomb flower far to the right in the Shadow Trials makes a chest containing arrows appear.

evidence.quote: shoot the bomb flower far to the right to make a chest appear. Longshot to it and open it for arrows.

subject: Small Key
text: Shooting the eye switch on the invisible path in the Shadow Trials makes a chest containing a Small Key appear.

evidence.quote: return to spot an eye switch. Shoot it to make a chest containing a Small Key appear.

subject: Light Trials
text: The Light Trials entrance is behind a giant stone that must be picked up and thrown.

evidence.quote: Last but not least, enter the Light Trials, the door with the yellow medallion. Where is it? It's behind a giant stone that you'll have to pick up and throw.

subject: Ice Blocks
text: Slashing the right torch removes the ice blocks blocking the fake wall in front of the Light Trials power source.

evidence.quote: Look with the Lens of Truth to see a fake wall ahead, but it's blocked by ice blocks. Slash the right torch to end up removing those blocks.

subject: Boss Key
text: Defeating two Stalfos in Ganon's Tower lowers the flames surrounding a chest containing the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: where you're faced with two Stalfos. After defeating them, the door ahead will open and the flames surrounding the chest will lower. Open the chest for the BOSS KEY.

subject: Big Bullet Bag
text: The Big Bullet Bag is obtained from the Mad Scrub's shooting game in Lost Woods.

evidence.quote: Kill Gold Skulltula #4 in Kokiri Village, and the Big Bullet Bag from the Mad Scrub's shooting game in Lost Woods.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Heart Piece #1 is obtained from the Skull Kid choir in Lost Woods.

evidence.quote: Get Heart Piece #1 from the Skull Kid choir and a Deku Stick upgrade from a Business Scrub under the bridge to Hyrule Field, both in Lost Woods.

subject: Deku Stick Upgrade
text: A Deku Stick upgrade is obtained from a Business Scrub under the bridge to Hyrule Field in Lost Woods.

evidence.quote: Get Heart Piece #1 from the Skull Kid choir and a Deku Stick upgrade from a Business Scrub under the bridge to Hyrule Field, both in Lost Woods.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Gold Skulltula #5 is located in the guard shack in Castle Town.

evidence.quote: In Castle Town, kill Gold Skulltula #5 in the guard shack, and win the Biggest Bullet Bag from the shooting gallery.

subject: Biggest Bullet Bag
text: The Biggest Bullet Bag is won from the shooting gallery in Castle Town.

evidence.quote: In Castle Town, kill Gold Skulltula #5 in the guard shack, and win the Biggest Bullet Bag from the shooting gallery.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Heart Piece #2 is obtained in Castle Town by giving the obese lady her dog back.

evidence.quote: Kill Gold Skulltula #6 from a tree at Hyrule Castle Grounds, then get Heart Piece #2 in Castle Town by giving the obese lady her dog back.

subject: Bottle
text: The first bottle is obtained at Lon Lon Ranch by finding Talon's Super Cucco.

evidence.quote: Get your first bottle at Lon Lon Ranch by finding Talon's Super Cucco, then kill Gold Skulltulas #7 and #8, get Heart Piece #3 in the silo, and learn Epona's Song by talking to Malon enough times.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Heart Piece #3 is located in the silo at Lon Lon Ranch.

evidence.quote: Get your first bottle at Lon Lon Ranch by finding Talon's Super Cucco, then kill Gold Skulltulas #7 and #8, get Heart Piece #3 in the silo, and learn Epona's Song by talking to Malon enough times.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Heart Piece #4 is obtained from the lone Skull Kid standing on a stump.

evidence.quote: Learn Saria's Song, then get Heart Piece #4 from the lone Skull Kid standing on a stump.

subject: Adult's Wallet
text: The Adult's Wallet is obtained from the Gold Skulltula house in Kakariko.

evidence.quote: Get the Adult's Wallet from the Gold Skulltula house in Kakariko, get your second bottle from the Cucco lady by gathering her Cuccos, then kill Gold Skulltulas #12 through #16 at night.

subject: Bottle
text: The second bottle is obtained from the Cucco lady in Kakariko by gathering her Cuccos.

evidence.quote: Get the Adult's Wallet from the Gold Skulltula house in Kakariko, get your second bottle from the Cucco lady by gathering her Cuccos, then kill Gold Skulltulas #12 through #16 at night.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Heart Piece #5 is obtained by having Dampe dig it up in Kakariko Graveyard.

evidence.quote: Get Heart Piece #5 by having Dampe dig it up, Gold Skulltula #17, and the Hylian Shield under a grave in Kakariko Graveyard.

subject: Hylian Shield
text: The Hylian Shield is found under a grave in Kakariko Graveyard.

evidence.quote: Get Heart Piece #5 by having Dampe dig it up, Gold Skulltula #17, and the Hylian Shield under a grave in Kakariko Graveyard.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Heart Piece #6 is found underneath another grave in Kakariko Graveyard.

evidence.quote: Learn the Sun's Song, get Heart Piece #6 underneath another grave, then head up Death Mountain.

subject: Goron's Bracelet
text: Link gets the Goron's Bracelet in Goron City.

evidence.quote: Head up to Goron City, get the Goron's Bracelet, Heart Piece #7 by bombing the pot once it starts spinning (light the torches), and Gold Skulltula #18.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Heart Piece #7 is obtained in Goron City by lighting the torches and bombing the pot once it starts spinning.

evidence.quote: Head up to Goron City, get the Goron's Bracelet, Heart Piece #7 by bombing the pot once it starts spinning (light the torches), and Gold Skulltula #18.
